svg.title: IDEA Engineering candidate container view
svg.desc: Engineers use the Web workbench or Desktop. Administrators use the Administration Web application. All protected requests go to one IDEA Server, which owns authorization and product coordination and accesses the relational and private Artifact stores. The Workspace process alone manages local working files. Format processing is isolated from the main Server.
